svg.title: Where versioning sits: interpreted once, then invisible
svg.desc: Pipeline: source, parse and HIR, versioning::analyze (the only version-aware analysis), driver fan-out, one projection per version through version-free layers to per-version output; the adapter stage is the only stage that sees every version.
svg.text: Where versioning sits: interpreted once, then invisible
Only versioning::analyze reads lifecycle annotations. After project(), every layer sees one ordinary spec.
annotations carried as data, nothing interpreted yet
LifecycleRecord: intervals, names, presence, types per DeclPath
typed diagnostics (unknown version, empty interval, overlaps ...)
driver: selection -> Vec<VersionId>, then fan out
for each v: project(&spec, &record, v) -> Projection { spec, info }
the only stage that sees every version
emits steps, hooks and one dispatcher
tell the contract was ever versioned,
